B. Calculations for the Nutrient
Prescription: Determine kcal to be
supplied from 10% lipid.
2000  0.30  600 kcal
 
Determine grams of lipid by dividing 
kcal from lipid by 11.
 
Using 30% calculation: 
600/11 kcal/g  54.5 g (round to 55 g)
 
Divide lipid grams by total daily
volume ( ﬂ uid needs or ﬁ nal
rate  24) in mL and multiply by 
100 to determine % lipid.
55/2000  100  2.75% lipid or
27 g/L (round to 3%)
